<thought>To obtain a usable retrosynthetic template, I will search the catalog for transformations that break a ketone and form an aliphatic hydroxyl (the core of a carbonyl‑ene reaction). This should return at least one template ID that can be applied to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]","functional_groups_broken":["ketones"],"functional_groups_formed":["aliphatic hydroxyls"],"limit":5}
